decisions.reason: Correcting the depicted author's identity and photo source does not change the existing small circular presentation requirements.
The supplied page is a source for correct author photos, not a change to where article content must be gathered.
Replacing an incorrect author photo does not modify the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The author-photo correction does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable or format.
The source changes photo identity and provenance, not the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The author-photo correction does not alter the deferred print-ready deliverable, resolution, or prepress settings.
Using the correct author photos does not change the obligation to create the magazine layout template.
The author-photo source URL does not change the flipbook platform cost requirement or candidate platforms.
The author-photo correction does not affect the inaugural-edition or November 1st issue labeling.
